texts.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，以至于新鲜感开始喜忧参半。少数乘客在各个停靠港之间焦躁不安，请求永久下船定居；而下方，当地人则在订票柜台前排队，争抢船上的任何一个铺位，渴望亲身体验宣传册中承诺的种种奇观。
texts.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for the novelty to cut both ways. A handful of passengers, restless between ports of call, ask to be set ashore for good; below, locals queue at the booking desk for any berth aboard, eager to taste the wonders the brochures promised.

texts.zh: 我们的活体陈设与[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的人口已开始在我们船体边界两侧进行温和的接触。他们中有些人请求登上[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]避难；我们中也有些人渴望感受开阔的天空。或许允许这场迁徙，能最大化有机体的福祉。
texts.en: Our bio-trophies and the population of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] have begun gentle overtures across our hulls' boundary. Some of theirs ask sanctuary aboard [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]; some of ours wish to taste open sky. Perhaps we would maximize organic well-being by allowing the migration.

texts.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，船员与当地人都已认出彼此的血缘亲情。如今，双方各有少数人请求互换铺位：已定居的表亲渴望奔赴广阔虚空，漂泊者则被亲族所在的坚实土地所吸引。
texts.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to recognize their kinship. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled cousins eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground among family.

texts.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停泊了足够长的时间，船员与当地人已对彼此有了充分的了解。现在，双方都有少数人请求互换归宿：定居者渴望拥抱无垠的虚空，而漂泊者则向往脚下坚实的土地。
texts.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to take measure of one another. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled folk eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground beneath their feet.

label.zh: 让他们签约，并欢迎我们的访客登船。
label.en: Let them sign on, and welcome our visitors aboard.

summary.text:
# 漂泊者与定居者 / Drifters and Settlers

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-60; events/nomads_events_1.txt:17043-17260 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

方舟舰事件调度 arkship.1 调用 nomads.7000；非杀戮型、已遇见其他物种的帝国（格式塔仅限机仆或永恒航行）若尚无迁徙说明标记，收到 nomads.7005。

The arkship event dispatcher arkship.1 calls nomads.7000; a non-homicidal empire that has met other species (gestalts only if Rogue Servitor or Forever Cruise) without the migration-information flag receives nomads.7005.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

说明游牧民与定居者之间的人口迁徙。

It explains population migration between drifters and settlers.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

三个选项决定对迁徙的态度（亲外与排外各受限制）。

Three options set the stance on migration (restricted for xenophiles and xenophobes respectively).
